newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.495 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.495 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended January 11 was 5,495,295 gallons compared with 4,591,917 gallons last week.
Imports were 1,845,336 gallons compared with 459,065 gallonsthe previous week.
There were 14,809 domestic receipts this week compared with 14,713 domestic receipts the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,141,198 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,846,296 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 28,704,484 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 11,740,832 gallons.
